title: Aliens take people to build a critical mass

tellings.quote: I also ask them why they take some people like they took me and tomorrow they might take you and so on.

plain: A man introduced on the show as the president of a Russian republic, not otherwise named in these tellings, says aliens took him in 1997, and that he asked them why they take some people: "like they took me and tomorrow they might take you and so on." He tells it as something that happened to him, and the story's point is that the beings are taking people one by one to build up a critical mass of humans who have had contact.
